# Aevum Solutions

> Independent advisory for B2B post-sales leaders. AI-augmented operating models, agent workflows, and escalation logic — implementation through renewal. Designed by an operator who's run them at enterprise scale.

Aevum Solutions helps engineering-led B2B SaaS founders and growth-stage post-sales leaders design and implement AI-augmented post-sales operating models. The work spans implementation, customer success, renewals, and escalation logic — without scaling headcount linearly. Led by a senior operator who has run technical post-sales functions at enterprise scale.
